glossary.definition:
(A) "Assist suicide" or "assisting suicide" means knowingly doing either of the following, with the purpose of helping another person to commit or attempt suicide:

(1) Providing the physical means by which the person commits or attempts to commit suicide;

(2) Participating in a physical act by which the person commits or attempts to commit suicide.

(B) "Certified nurse practitioner," "certified nurse-midwife," and "clinical nurse specialist" have the same meanings as in section 4723.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3795.01 , 3795.02 , and 3795.03 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Health care" means any care, treatment, service, or procedure to maintain, diagnose, or treat a person's physical or mental condition.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3795.01 , 3795.02 , and 3795.03 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Health care decision" means informed consent, refusal to give informed consent, or withdrawal of informed consent to health care.

glossary.definition: (G) "Health care personnel" means physicians, nurses, physician assistants, emergency medical technicians-basic, emergency medical technicians-intermediate, emergency medical technicians-paramedic, medical technicians, dietitians, other authorized persons acting under the direction of an attending physician, and administrators of health care facilities.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3795.01 , 3795.02 , and 3795.03 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Physician" means a person who is authorized under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery.
